targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS running_runs FROM pipeline_run_overview WHERE run_status = 'running';
SELECT count(*) AS failed_runs FROM pipeline_run_overview WHERE run_status = 'failed';
SELECT created_at, event_type, source, run_status, correlation_id FROM pipeline_event_timeline ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT id::text AS id, title::text AS title, subtitle::text AS subtitle, mainstat::text AS mainstat, secondarystat::text AS secondarystat, node_type::text AS node_type, status::text AS status, "nodeRadius", color::text AS color FROM pipeline_graph_nodes WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'placeholder:no-recent-flow' AS id, 'No recent pipeline flow' AS title, 'last 24 hours' AS subtitle, 'idle' AS mainstat, '' AS secondarystat, 'placeholder' AS node_type, NULL::text AS status, 42::numeric AS "nodeRadius", 'gray' AS color WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pipeline_graph_nodes WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') ORDER BY id;

SELECT id::text AS id, source::text AS source, target::text AS target, mainstat::text AS mainstat, secondarystat::text AS secondarystat, edge_type::text AS edge_type FROM pipeline_graph_edges WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY id;
